calls.why: Same weight as last time, three sets, and no jump tonight. Four sets, same weight. Last time the row machine was the pulldown station so you did one-arm dumbbell rows instead - if that happens again, swapping is fine and it does not count as a missed lift.
No pain, no fatigue signal, and curls cost almost nothing in recovery terms. I have no brake to apply here - the load call belongs to the progression seat.
